correctness.rationale: The exact finite-state first-step hitting equations, strict superharmonic (K/lambda)^|S|, and subset-size induction produce a rare extinction probability of order lambda^-(n-1). Renewal from full occupancy with O(lambda^-1) excursions gives its reciprocal mean. Decomposing pinned-coordinate integral by total order yields C_G, and tree edge differences are unimodular independent coordinates giving product (1/w_uv+1/w_vu). Added positive edge shrinks integrand a.e. Independent exact rational recurrence equals product across all 1441 labelled trees n=2..6 with asymmetric weights; P3 C=4, triangle C=3/2. Infinite/all-tree assertion rests on the proof.

Adding positive bidirected edge strictly increases the leading lifetime factor.
